# EduMoe

> A free educational platform for Egyptian university students, built around
> MoeAI: a curriculum-aware AI tutor that answers in Egyptian Arabic,
> Franco-Arabic, or English, grounded in the student's actual syllabus.

EduMoe began as a Telegram channel (t.me/CS_Epic_Save) serving roughly 230
first-year Computer Science students. It is now a web platform with a mobile client.

MoeAI is the tutoring layer. It differs from a general assistant in three ways:
it retrieves the student's own lecture material before answering, it detects and
mirrors the student's language per message rather than defaulting to English,
and it keeps a per-student model of misconceptions and progress across sessions.

## Pages

- /: overview and entry point
- /moeai: the tutor chat
- /courses: first-year Computer Science lectures and notes
- /quizzes: practice questions generated from lecture material
- /simulators: interactive C++ and logic-design simulators
- /ranked: live competitive quiz matches
- /dashboard: personal progress and what MoeAI suggests revising
- /about: team and background
- /legal: terms, privacy (Egypt Law 151/2020), and cookies
